# proxcenter_images (Data Source)

Catalogue images the token may deploy (source.image of a proxcenter_vm). Needs a VM scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxcenter_images" "debian" {
  vendor = "debian"
}

output "debian_images" {
  value = data.proxcenter_images.debian.images[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `vendor` (String) Only the images of this vendor.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) The images, built-in and custom. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `format` (String) qcow2, raw, img or iso.
- `is_custom` (Boolean) Whether the image was added in ProxCenter rather than built in.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Identifier to use as source.image.
- `vendor` (String) Distribution or vendor, e.g. debian.
- `version` (String) Version of the image.
